lede: Voice studio at Texas A&M International University. Applied Voice, Studio Class, Junior & Senior Performance, Choir Ensemble, Voice Method, and Art Song Literature.
body_html:
Dr. Hwang leads the voice and choir programs at Texas A&M International University, where she teaches Applied Voice, Applied Studio Class, Junior and Senior Performance, Choir Ensemble, Voice Method, and Art Song Literature. Her pedagogy combines rigorous bel canto technique with healthy vocal production and an emphasis on text, language, and stagecraft.

Students of all levels are welcome — from undergraduates building a foundation to graduate-level singers preparing for competitions and auditions. Masterclasses available by invitation.

courses.title: Applied Voice
courses.desc: Private studio instruction in classical voice technique, repertoire, and performance practice. (MUAP 1213, 3113, 3213)

courses.title: Applied Studio Class
courses.desc: Group studio sessions focusing on performance, repertoire study, and collegial critique. (MUAP 1013, 3013)

courses.title: Junior Performance
courses.desc: Preparation and presentation of the junior recital, integrating technique, language, and stage presence. (MUAP 3005, 3105)

courses.title: Senior Performance
courses.desc: Advanced recital preparation and full solo program presentation at the senior level. (MUAP 4105)

courses.title: Choir Ensemble
courses.desc: University choir building ensemble technique, choral literature, and a season of major works. (MUEN 1030, 1130, 3030, 3130)

courses.title: Voice Method
courses.desc: Pedagogy course for music education students — vocal anatomy, healthy production, and age-appropriate repertoire. (MUSI 3183)

courses.title: Art Song Literature
courses.desc: Survey of art song repertoire across German Lied, French mélodie, English, Italian, and Korean traditions. (MUSI 3321)
